summary_1line: Vibhishana warns Ravana and his courtiers that keeping Sita will doom Lanka, but the arrogant ministers dismiss the danger and boast of their strength.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vibhishana stands in Ravana’s jeweled court, raising a warning hand while the demon ministers glare and the ten-headed king sits on his throne.
Vibhishana compares Sita to a deadly serpent, speaking before the assembly as courtiers armed with maces and armor crowd the hall.
Prahasta proudly declares fearlessness before the court of Lanka, while Vibhishana looks on with grave concern.
